authentication: user key via in-memory bearer header; free daily allowance only
projection: Public bibliographic metadata; titles, abstracts, affiliations and paper text omitted
pagination: 100/page; one paging strategy per completed monthly partition; complete cursor partitions retained, incomplete cursor prefixes re-fetched with numbered pages below 10000-result limit

reconciliation.issue: Mixed cursor/numbered pagination produced overlaps within some months. No analysis accepted those pages. All mixed months were converted to numbered pagination by reacquiring their cursor prefix; partitions are below the 10000-result limit.
reconciliation.checks_required: All partition totals, page hashes, scope filters, and global unique work IDs must pass before producing statistics.
